summary: Prepared 15 illustrated place, experience and stay-area detail pages, connected them to the destination pilots, expanded the large-screen layout, and added a manually controlled photo journey with optional original ambient sound. An AI-film scene plan is documented; no AI video or true 360 footage was generated.

browser_checks: Illustrated Mangalajodi inner page loads with no horizontal overflow
Konark mobile photo journey: no horizontal overflow
Next chapter changes the visible scene; one scene remains visible
Sound is initially off; user gesture changes sound to on and starts playback
Pause stops playback and resets sound off
validation.full_screen: Native mode unverified; embedded-browser input/display behavior was inconclusive

limitations: Stay pages are base-area research guides, not individual property reviews; images depict settings rather than rooms.
AI video generation is unavailable in the connected tools. The delivered journey is explicitly a photo sequence, not 360 footage.
Audio is an original synthetic ambient prototype, not a field recording; subjective listening quality was not verified.
Full-screen control is implemented but native full-screen behavior was not conclusively verified in the embedded browser.
Browser emulation and layout checks do not replace real-device or screen-reader review.
Current provider, access, availability and journey-time checks remain open.
source_change: Earlier Chilika nature-camps destination URL returned a 404 on recheck; replaced with an equivalent official bird-watching guide found through indexed text, with inspection limits recorded.
publication: Draft review branch only; not merged or deployed
